name: Simple Thing
author: electrodash27
description: At 55%, spam right after you enter the UFO portal to go above the level. Stay slightly above the gameplay until 58% where you can spam above the level. Maintain a constant position under the gameplay until 65% where you can aim to go as far and as high from the last pillar as you can before your controls get disabled. Start spamming at 68% so when you regain controls you go above the level. Stay above the level until the end from there.
